fusions.name: Slick Dart
fusions.desc: Flicks a venomed dart at a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds up to 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: From the Reeds
fusions.desc: Springs 7 tiles onto the target, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Coated Before the Leap
fusions.desc: Increases your poison damage by 30% for 12 seconds, and you spring 2 tiles when you use it.

fusions.name: Bred Into the Venom
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
